race.comment: MRS FLANDERS (7) missed the placings when resuming at Newcastle two runs back then improved last start but found a couple better over 900m at the same venue. Finds the right race this time and can find winning form. MR BAZZA (2) finds the maiden win elusive but resumes in new colours and has been fitted with a solid trial in readiness. Drawn cosy for Keatings and looms as a major threat. EDNA MAE (5) closed off well on debut and can only improve further out in trip. Rates well and has to be included. THEGIRLFROMPRAGUE (9) a big watch first up for Matt Dale.
